tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ultraviolet — the primary brand colour. Logo mark, primary buttons, links and key accents. Text in brand on surface passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep violet for the tonal mark, pressed states and large dark brand fields. Decorative on the dark ground — never text there.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Lilac tint for the tonal mark, illustrations and selected backgrounds. Decorative on light (2.8:1) — never body text on surface.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Faint violet fill: chips, hovered rows, highlight panels.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Spark lime — the breakout quarter of the mark. Use sparingly: one moment per screen (a launch CTA, a live badge). Pair with ink text (14:1), never with white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and on spark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, taglines on surface (6.4:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — a violet-tinted off-white, a near-black violet in dark.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and the reversed mark on a brand fill (6.9:1 on light brand).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between the mark's quarters at 96px; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, logo clear-space minimum at small sizes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards — echoes the mark's rounded outer corners.
